SiteNav.slogan: Reserve a table at a restaurant you love, with confirmation in minutes.

Hero.baslikVarsayilan: Your <v>table</v> is ready at the best restaurants in your city.
Hero.baslikSehirli: Your <v>table</v> is ready at the best restaurants in {sehirEki}.
Hero.aciklama: Choose your city, date and time, and send your reservation request to the restaurant in seconds. Get the response by email.

Anasayfa.metaBaslik: Reserve Your Table at Restaurants, Send a Free Reservation Request
Anasayfa.metaAciklama: Discover restaurants in your city, choose a date and time, and send your reservation request to the restaurant in seconds. No sign-up required, completely free.
Anasayfa.restoranaDogrudanAciklama: No middleman — your request goes directly to the restaurant
Anasayfa.epostaAciklama: You'll receive the restaurant's confirmation or rejection by email as soon as they respond
Anasayfa.dogrulanmisAciklama: Only guests who actually visited the restaurant can leave a review
Anasayfa.semtBaslik: Every neighborhood has its own table
Anasayfa.yorumSistemiBaslik: Only those who sat at the table have a say.
Anasayfa.yorumMadde1: Reviews can only be left by guests who actually visited the restaurant
Anasayfa.yorumMadde2: Guests are invited to leave a review after their visit
Anasayfa.yorumMadde3: The system is transparent and based 100% on real experiences
Anasayfa.henuzYorumYok: No experiences shared yet. Be the first to leave a review.
Anasayfa.nasilCalisirBaslik: Reach a restaurant in three steps
Anasayfa.nasilCalisirAciklama: No complicated sign-ups or payment steps. Send your request and wait for the restaurant's response.
Anasayfa.adim1Aciklama: Choose the location, date, time and number of guests, then find your restaurant.
Anasayfa.adim2Aciklama: Your reservation request is sent to the restaurant instantly.
Anasayfa.adim3Aciklama: You'll be notified when the restaurant confirms or declines your request.
Anasayfa.kapanisBaslik: A great evening starts with the right table.
